Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kw motor.
Our latest forecast for part:350011 grows +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
We commit to a binding volume of 6,110 pcs per year over 12 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge the confirmed increase in your volume forecast and have incorporated this into our calculation, reducing the unit price to €369.02. As you offered faster payment in exchange for a better price, we have adjusted the payment terms from your proposed 90 days to 30 days net to facilitate this reduction. 

Our current proposal stands at a price of €373.13 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Alternatively, at our standard terms, we can offer a price of €369.02 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €369.02 per unit. 

The requested cost breakdown will be provided by our specialized department. Please note that our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our offer is a price of €372.55 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

We have already taken that volume change data into account. We have reviewed the forecast data you provided; however, please note that this specific data was already incorporated into our previous calculation and therefore does not enable further price reductions. 

As an alternative at our standard terms, a price of €368.45 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. To accommodate your request for a better price in exchange for faster payment, we have adjusted the payment terms to 30 days net, allowing us to offer a unit price of €368.45. 

We have made a further concession in response to your improved offer and trust this brings us closer to a final agreement. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
